role: Holds the single constant for how long a recording session waits for a dropped strap before StrapLinkCoordinator sets PolarManager.reconnectExhausted.
toplevel: Declares `static let windowSeconds: TimeInterval = 20 * 60`, read by StrapLinkCoordinator (log line at StrapLinkCoordinator.swift:~255 and the reconnect deadline task). No units.
